label: Перо
description: A 10-sentence usage card for перо (feather; pen).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Перо' stays in the nominative case as the neuter subject lying on the table. 'Белое' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Перо' is the accusative direct object of 'нашёл'; neuter nouns look identical in nominative and accusative. 'Птичье' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Пером' is the instrumental case, the tool used for writing. 'Старым' agrees in the neuter instrumental. The instrumental answers 'with what'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Пера' is the genitive form after 'у' to show whose tip is broken. 'Этого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative with prepositional setting. 'Перо' is the nominative subject that got stained, while 'в чернилах' gives the prepositional context. A natural descriptive sentence.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Перу' is the dative form after 'к' marking the goal of motion. 'Лёгкому' agrees in the neuter dative.

missions.phrase: Я часто думаю об этом пере.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О пере' uses the prepositional form 'пере' after 'об' to express thinking about the pen. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Перья' is the irregular nominative plural of 'перо', the subject lying on the ground. 'Разноцветные' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Перьев' is the genitive plural after 'из' showing the material. The irregular plural stem 'перь-' is required throughout the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Перо' is nominative as the subject. 'Острое' is the agreeing neuter predicate adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A clean descriptive model.
